issue.title: Quantum encryption algorithm fails when requests.teleport() is invoked
issue.body:
### Description
Calling `requests.teleport('quantum://satellite')` causes a segmentation fault because the quantum entanglement module is not thread-safe.

### Steps to Reproduce
Run `requests.teleport()`.

### Expected Behavior
Instantly transmit HTTP packet over quantum entanglement.

### Actual Behavior
Module does not exist, claims impossible capabilities.
